phase2_visibility.fruit_visible_fraction.work_unit: fruit visibility evaluations (real per-fruit AVUB-style area-weighted fraction)

phase3_motion_time.move_time.work_unit: one real T3.3 trapezoidal-profile move-time evaluation (5 axes)

phase4_semantic_map.integrate_semantic_v.work_unit: valid pixels semantic-integrated into the voxel class-count map (pixel_stride=2)

phase4_information_gain.batch_informatio.work_unit: (candidate pose x ray x march-step) volumetric entropy evaluations, fully vectorized/batched

phase4_roadmap.dijkstra.work_unit: one shortest-path solve over the real roadmap graph

note: All timings are wall-clock (time.perf_counter, warmup=2, then N repeated calls) on the CPU running this job -- see PHASE6_LOG.md for the machine context.
